bounded_checks.findings: Graph corrections, all from the Methods passages above: added nuclei isolation/permeabilization before the run-on; named the run-on buffer (400 mM KCl, 0.05% Sarkosyl, 5 min 37 C) and the four 50 uM 3'-O-propargyl NTPs; added the FACS partition of single cells into 96 urea wells, which is where the cell barcode is assigned; gave CuAAC its catalyst (CuSO4/sodium ascorbate/BTTAA) and conditions (15% PEG 8000, 2.66 M urea, 2 h 50 C) and added the EDTA quench, TRIzol and 3 kDa Amicon cleanup with its discarded reagents; ZnCl2 now carries 10 mM/5 min/65 C; RT names RNase H- M-MuLV (Thermo EP0751, 16% PEG, 2 h 50 C) and gains the 1 uM RT primer that the hairpin design omits. Added the missing 10% denaturing-PAGE size selection that physically removes unclicked adaptor and empty cDNA before pre-amplification, keeping a residual empty-cDNA branch so DASH remains a cleavage that blocks amplification rather than a physical removal. Both PCRs now name NEBNext Ultra II Q5 (M0544) and the split P5-/P7-side 0.5 uM dual-index primers, with the Supplementary Table 8 six-cycle 98/60/72 C program. Page shows a source discrepancy: the Methods call the final PCR 'two-step' while Supplementary Table 9 reprints the same six-cycle program, so the model asserts no final cycle count.
